profiles.label: Stores
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find direct people-present occupancy evidence for Stores in the Retail and Service Outlets land-use group. Use only direct evidence of people physically present during a bounded incident, event, shift, measurement, or observation. Treat capacities, staffing, rooms, area, ridership, and annual traffic as context unless the analyst overrides count mode.
preferred_source_types: credible news reports with observed counts
positive_evidence_patterns: people present at a bounded time
observed attendance or occupancy count
incident/event/shift count tied to a facility and date or period
negative_evidence_patterns: capacity or descriptive context alone is not direct occupancy

profiles.label: Hotel/Motel
profiles.component_source_guidance: Collect source-backed component inputs only for this facility class. Keep each component role-labeled with value, unit, time basis, and geography level. Do not calculate a final derived occupancy estimate in v1.
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find source-backed population component inputs for Hotel/Motel in the Retail and Service Outlets land-use group. Target fields: Number of rooms, number of suites, hotel stars, average room size, average suite size, Hotel Occupancy Rate. Do not derive a final occupancy estimate.
context_only_source_types: marketing descriptions without numeric component values
calculated occupancy totals derived by the model
positive_evidence_patterns: Number of rooms: numeric source-backed component input
number of suites: numeric source-backed component input
hotel stars: numeric source-backed component input
average room size: numeric source-backed component input
average suite size: numeric source-backed component input
negative_evidence_patterns: derived total occupancy estimate without source support
component value with no exact quote
numeric value without unit or time basis
